docs.title: Welcome to ApexPathAI
docs.text:
ApexPathAI is an open-source autonomous vehicle localization, state estimation, and proving ground validation platform. It integrates state estimation theory with real-time telemetry streaming and automated safety verification on closed-circuit proving grounds.

flowchart LR
    A[Sensors & Datasets] --> B[MapManager / EDT]
    B --> C[CTRV EKF & 15-DOF ESKF]
    C --> D[Frenet Path Guidance]
    D --> E[Session Orchestrator]
    E --> F[20 Hz Glass Cockpit]

docs.title: Key Capabilities
docs.text:
1. Dual State Estimation Stacks:
  2. 5-State Planar CTRV EKF: Real-time localization with exact circular-arc integration, continuous-to-discrete process noise projection, manifold angle wrapping on \(S^1\), and Joseph-stabilized covariance updates.
  3. 15-DOF Error-State Kalman Filter: High-rate strapdown inertial mechanization on \(\text{SE}(3) \times \mathbb{R}^6\) with unit quaternion orientation on \(\text{SO}(3)\) and online accelerometer/gyroscope bias tracking.
  4. Proving Ground Automated Validation:
  5. Automated 7-rule KPI scorecard verifying position accuracy, lateral deviation, geofence clearance, horizontal protection level (HPL), NEES filter consistency, MPC determinism, and disengagements.
  6. Deterministic Fault Injection:
  7. Proving-ground scenario execution simulating tunnel GNSS blackouts, urban canyon multipath reflections, and camera glare blinding.
  8. Interactive Glass-Cockpit Dashboard:
  9. 8-screen engineering interface exposing high-frequency telemetry via WebSockets and REST APIs at 20 Hz.

docs.title: Quickstart Guide
docs.text: This guide walks you through setting up ApexPathAI and launching the real-time engineering telemetry cockpit.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Python 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, or 3.13
  • Operating System: Linux, Windows, or macOS

docs.title: Step-by-Step Setup
docs.text:
# 1. Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/YourOrg/ApexPathAI.git
cd ApexPathAI

# 2. Create virtual environment
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate       # On Linux/macOS
# or: .venv\Scripts\activate    # On Windows

# 3. Install in editable mode
pip install -e .

docs.title: Running the Live Cockpit
docs.text:
Launch the cockpit on your chosen circuit (e.g. Monza, Spa, Silverstone):

apexpath-cockpit --track Monza --port 8000

Open http://127.0.0.1:8000 in your web browser.

docs.title: Key Cockpit Controls
docs.text:
• Circuit Selector: Switch instantly between 23 international Grand Prix tracks.
  • E-STOP Button: Actuates emergency stopping, disengages autonomy, and logs critical safety incidents.
  • Simulation Controls: Pause, Play, Step-forward, or adjust simulation playback speed (0.5x to 5.0x).
  • Proving Ground Scenarios: Trigger automated test profiles (Nominal Raceline, Tunnel GNSS Outage, Urban Canyon Multipath).

docs.title: Running Offline Benchmarks
docs.text:
To evaluate state estimation accuracy across all 23 racetrack datasets:

apexpath-benchmark

This runs closed-loop filtering and prints the multi-track performance report including RMSE, CEP50/95, Frenet lateral deviations, and filter improvements.

docs.title: REST & WebSocket API Reference 📡
docs.text:
ApexPathAI exposes a comprehensive RESTful API and a high-frequency WebSocket streaming endpoint under /api/v1.

Interactive OpenAPI documentation is available live at: - Swagger UI: http://localhost:8000/docs - ReDoc: http://localhost:8000/redoc

docs.title: GET /api/v1/monitoring/snapshot
docs.text: Returns the latest instantaneous vehicle pose, twist, actuation, sensor health, and Frenet tracking status.

docs.title: POST /api/v1/monitoring/estop
docs.text: Triggers an immediate software Emergency Stop (E-STOP), bringing actuator demands to zero and logging an emergency event.

docs.title: POST /api/v1/monitoring/reset-estop
docs.text: Clears active emergency stops and returns the platform to ready status.

docs.title: WS /api/v1/monitoring/ws
docs.text:
Full-duplex WebSocket streaming at 20 Hz (50 ms epoch). Pushes JSON telemetry frames: 

{
  "timestamp": 12.45,
  "circuit": "Monza",
  "vehicle_id": "apex-f1tenth-01",
  "pose": { "x": 124.5, "y": 88.2, "theta_rad": 1.54, "theta_deg": 88.2 },
  "twist": { "linear_mps": 18.4, "angular_radps": 0.12 },
  "dynamics": { "speed_kph": 66.2, "accel_mps2": 1.2, "lat_accel_g": 0.42 },
  "actuation": { "steering_angle_deg": -2.4, "target_velocity_mps": 20.0, "cross_track_error_m": 0.08 },
  "diagnostics": { "active_primary_source": "FUSION_EKF", "overall_confidence": 0.96 }
}

docs.title: 🏎️ 2. Vehicle Fleet Management
docs.text:
• GET /api/v1/vehicles: List all registered fleet vehicles.
  • GET /api/v1/vehicles/{vehicle_id}: Retrieve vehicle parameters and sensor extrinsics.
  • POST /api/v1/vehicles: Register a new vehicle model (wheelbase, max speed, steering limit).
  • PUT /api/v1/vehicles/{vehicle_id}: Update kinematic configurations.
  • DELETE /api/v1/vehicles/{vehicle_id}: Remove vehicle from fleet catalog.
  • POST /api/v1/vehicles/{vehicle_id}/select: Set active vehicle model.

docs.title: 🏁 3. Circuit Proving Grounds
docs.text:
• GET /api/v1/circuits: List all 23 available Grand Prix circuits with lengths and waypoint counts.
  • GET /api/v1/circuits/{circuit_name}: Retrieve detailed centerline and raceline coordinates preview.
  • POST /api/v1/circuits/select: Switch proving ground simulation to the specified circuit.

docs.title: ⏱️ 4. Test Session Management
docs.text:
• GET /api/v1/sessions: List historical test sessions.
  • GET /api/v1/sessions/active: Retrieve current running session with live sector splits.
  • GET /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}: Detailed session metrics and lap records.
  • POST /api/v1/sessions: Create and configure a new test campaign.
  • POST /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/transition: Command lifecycle state change (arm, start, pause, stop, abort).

docs.title: 📐 5. Localization & Vehicle Analytics
docs.text:
• GET /api/v1/analytics/summary: Instantaneous statistical summary (RMSE, max position error, sample count).
  • GET /api/v1/analytics/localization: Deep localization metrics (CEP50, CEP95, Maximum HPL, NEES).
  • GET /api/v1/analytics/dynamics: Dynamic envelope analysis (sideslip angle \(\beta\), lateral acceleration, curvature \(\kappa\)).

docs.title: 🛡️ 6. Sensor Diagnostics & Fault Injection
docs.text:
• GET /api/v1/sensors/matrix: Real-time health status and innovation residuals (NIS) for GNSS, LiDAR, Camera, and IMU.
  • POST /api/v1/sensors/fault: Inject controlled sensor disturbances (GNSS dropout, multipath noise, IMU drift).
  • POST /api/v1/sensors/fault/clear: Reset all active sensor faults.

docs.title: ⏪ 7. Incident Replay System
docs.text:
• GET /api/v1/replay/timeline: Retrieve scrubbable replay buffer with auto-bookmarked incidents.
  • POST /api/v1/replay/seek: Seek playback position to specific timestamp.
  • POST /api/v1/replay/control: Control playback state (play, pause, step_forward, step_backward, reset).

docs.title: 🏆 8. Regulatory KPI Analysis
docs.text:
• GET /api/v1/kpis/rules: List all 7 regulatory safety rules and tolerance thresholds.
  • GET /api/v1/kpis/evaluate: Evaluate real-time performance against ISO 21448 rules and return pass/fail scorecard.

docs.title: 📑 9. Validation Dossier Reporting
docs.text:
• GET /api/v1/reports: List compiled proving ground audit dossiers.
  • POST /api/v1/reports/generate: Compile formal validation dossier with executive summary and sign-offs.
  • GET /api/v1/reports/{report_id}: Retrieve report content (supports Markdown, JSON, and PDF formats).

docs.title: System Assumptions, Limitations & Known Issues ⚠️
docs.text: This document transparently specifies the theoretical assumptions, kinematic approximations, and operational boundaries of the OpenRaceStack and ApexPathAI frameworks.

docs.title: A. Planar 2D Track Envelope
docs.text:
• Assumption: Racetrack centerlines and vehicle states are modeled in the two-dimensional Cartesian plane \((\mathbb{R}^2)\) and Frenet curvilinear frame \((s, d)\).
  • Limitation: Elevation grade changes \((\theta_{\text{grade}})\) and track banking camber \((\theta_{\text{bank}})\) are not currently integrated into the single-track dynamics equations.
  • Operational Boundary: Validated for flat circuits or proving grounds with \(< 3\%\) banking angle.

docs.title: B. Single-Track Bicycle Dynamics & Lateral Load Transfer
docs.text:
• Assumption: Left and right tires on each axle are lumped into single equivalent front and rear contact points.
  • Limitation: While dynamic longitudinal load transfer (braking/acceleration pitch) and aerodynamic downforce are fully computed, lateral load transfer (chassis body roll and inner-versus-outer wheel unloading) is neglected.
  • Operational Boundary: Highly accurate for low-to-medium roll angles (\(a_y \le 2.5\,\text{G}\)). Vehicles exhibiting high roll compliance may experience unmodeled inner tire lift-off.

docs.title: C. Isothermal Tire Models
docs.text:
• Assumption: LinearTireModel and PacejkaTireModel assume a constant bulk tire friction coefficient \((\mu)\) and nominal cornering stiffness \((C_\alpha)\).
  • Limitation: Dynamic tire temperature buildup, thermal carcass expansion, and rubber graining degradation are not simulated.
  • Operational Boundary: Transient tire heating over multi-lap endurance stints is not reflected in tire force generation.

docs.title: A. Degenerate Geometry in LiDAR Scan Matching
docs.text:
• Limitation: In long, featureless straight tunnel sectors with completely parallel smooth walls, 2D ICP and NDT scan matching experience longitudinal aperture ambiguity along the direction of motion.
  • Mitigation: The dual Extended Kalman Filter (ekf_engine.py and eskf_3d.py) fuses wheel odometry and high-rate IMU dead-reckoning to constrain drift during geometric LiDAR degeneracy.

docs.title: B. Optical Feature Occlusion Under Direct Glare
docs.text: • Limitation: The visual feature tracker (visual_feature_tracker.py) simulates realistic optical feature loss under sun glare and tunnel dark-to-light transitions. Prolonged total optical loss requires fallback to dead-reckoning.

docs.title: A. Operating System CAN Interface
docs.text:
• Limitation: High-speed native SocketCAN and CAN FD hardware bus communication require a Linux kernel (can0, vcan0).
  • Operational Boundary: On Windows workstations, DallaraAV21VehicleInterface operates via simulated software loopback. Physical vehicle hardware deployment requires Linux Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or 24.04 LTS.

docs.title: B. Watchdog Heartbeat Preemption
docs.text: • Requirement: Low-level vehicle interfaces enforce a hard \(100\,\text{ms}\) heartbeat timeout. If the autonomy planner fails to dispatch a VehicleControlCommand within \(100\,\text{ms}\), the system immediately enters EMERGENCY_STOP status and commands maximum braking deceleration.

docs.title: Path Guidance & Kinematic Control
docs.text: ApexPathAI employs a Frenet-frame kinematic guidance system with optimal raceline curvature feedforward and predictive horizon rollout.

docs.title: 1. Frenet Tracking Error Kinematics
docs.text:
Given vehicle Cartesian position \((x, y)\) and heading \(\theta\), the vehicle is orthogonally projected onto the nearest racetrack centerline or raceline waypoint \((x_{\text{ref}}, y_{\text{ref}})\) with tangent orientation \(\psi_{\text{ref}}\):

\[\Delta x = x - x_{\text{ref}}, \quad \Delta y = y - y_{\text{ref}}\]

docs.title: Cross-Track Error (\(e_y\))
docs.text: $\(e_y = -\sin(\psi_{\text{ref}}) \Delta x + \cos(\psi_{\text{ref}}) \Delta y\)$ - \(e_y > 0\): Vehicle is to the left of the reference raceline. - \(e_y < 0\): Vehicle is to the right of the reference raceline.

docs.title: Heading Orientation Error (\(e_\psi\))
docs.text: \[e_\psi = \text{wrap}(\theta - \psi_{\text{ref}})\]

docs.title: Curvature Feedforward (\(\delta_{\text{ff}}\))
docs.text: To negotiate a turn of instantaneous reference curvature \(\kappa_{\text{ref}}\) with vehicle wheelbase \(L\): $\(\delta_{\text{ff}} = \arctan(L \cdot \kappa_{\text{ref}})\)$

docs.title: Feedback Correction (\(\delta_{\text{fb}}\))
docs.text: Cross-track error is nullified using Frenet guidance: $\(\psi_{\text{desired}} = -\arctan\left(\frac{k_{\text{guidance}} \cdot e_y}{\max(v, 1.0)}\right)\)$ $\(e_{\psi, \text{effective}} = \text{wrap}(e_\psi - \psi_{\text{desired}})\)$ $\(\delta_{\text{fb}} = -k_p \cdot e_y - k_d \cdot e_{\psi, \text{effective}}\)$

docs.title: Slew Rate & Saturation Envelopes
docs.text: \[\delta_{\text{raw}} = \delta_{\text{ff}} + \delta_{\text{fb}}$$ $$\Delta \delta = \text{clamp}(\delta_{\text{raw}} - \delta_{\text{prev}}, -\dot{\delta}_{\max} \Delta t, \dot{\delta}_{\max} \Delta t)$$ $$\delta_{\text{cmd}} = \text{clamp}(\delta_{\text{prev}} + \Delta \delta, -\delta_{\max}, \delta_{\max})\]

docs.title: 3. Horizon Preview Rollout
docs.text: Over the prediction horizon \(N_p\) (15 steps at \(\Delta t = 0.05\,\text{s}\)): $\(\begin{aligned} p_x(k+1) &= p_x(k) + v(k) \cos(\theta(k)) \Delta t \\ p_y(k+1) &= p_y(k) + v(k) \sin(\theta(k)) \Delta t \\ \theta(k+1) &= \text{wrap}\left(\theta(k) + \frac{v(k)}{L} \tan(\delta_{\text{cmd}}) \Delta t\right) \\ v(k+1) &= \max(0.0, v(k) + a_{\text{cmd}} \Delta t) \end{aligned}\)$ This forward projection provides trajectory preview vectors for collision checking and telemetry visualization.

docs.title: Enterprise Platform Architecture
docs.text: ApexPathAI is structured as an enterprise-grade Autonomous Vehicle (AV) Proving Ground Validation & State Estimation Platform. The platform decouples presentation, high-speed telemetry streaming, state estimation algorithms, and persistent storage.

docs.title: 1. Frontend Architecture (frontend/)
docs.text:
• Modern Stack: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Material UI (MUI v5), Mapbox GL, Recharts.
  • Dark Cockpit Aesthetic: Specially crafted dark aeronautic color scheme (#0B0F19 void background, #00E5FF electric cyan, #00E676 telemetry green, #FF3D71 emergency stop).
  • 10 Modular Screen Views:
  • LiveCockpit: Real-time 20 Hz instrument cluster with G-force display, speed gauge, and Stanford error plane.
  • VehicleCatalog: Fleet management and physical parameter tuning.
  • CircuitList: Interactive 23-track gallery with downsampled centerline previews.
  • SessionManager: Test campaign execution, sector split times, and state transitions.
  • LocalizationAnalytics: CEP50, CEP95, HPL, and NEES consistency charts.
  • VehicleAnalytics: Tire sideslip angle (\(\beta\)), curvature, and acceleration envelope.
  • SensorDiagnostics: Live innovation residuals (NIS) and fault injection buttons.
  • ReplayScrubber: Incident scrubber with interactive seek bar and playback rate controls.
  • KPIScorecardTable: Automated pass/fail matrix against ISO 21448 thresholds.
  • ReportGenerator: Formal validation dossier compiler with Markdown and JSON exports.

docs.title: 2. Backend Application Core (backend/app/)
docs.text:
• Application Factory: Configured with FastAPI lifespan managers for clean startup and asynchronous shutdown.
  • Pydantic v2 Contracts: Strict data validation models ensuring deterministic API payloads across all endpoints.
  • Dual Database Strategy:
  • Production: Async SQLAlchemy with asyncpg connecting to PostgreSQL 16.
  • Zero-Config Developer Onboarding: Automatic fallback to SQLite (sqlite+aiosqlite) when running standalone without external Docker containers.
  • Pub/Sub Telemetry Broker:
  • Redis 7 pub/sub for high-throughput distributed fanout.
  • In-memory event broker fallback for single-instance development.

docs.title: 3. Autonomous Kinematics & Estimation Core (Localization/core/)
docs.text:
• Dual-Stack Fusion:
  • Planar CTRV EKF: 5-state vector \([p_x, p_y, \theta, v, \omega]^T\) tracking high-speed planar motion on \(S^1\) manifold.
  • 15-DOF ESKF: 3D strapdown inertial navigation on \(\text{SE}(3) \times \mathbb{R}^6\) with unit quaternion error propagation.
  • Frenet Model Predictive Guidance:
  • Coordinates tracking against precomputed optimal racelines.
  • Cross-track error (\(e_y\)) and heading alignment (\(e_\psi\)) calculations.

docs.title: State Estimation Mathematical Formulations
docs.text: ApexPathAI incorporates two complementary state estimators: 1. Planar 5-State CTRV EKF (LocalizationEKF) 2. 3D 15-DOF Error-State Kalman Filter on \(\text{SE}(3) \times \mathbb{R}^6\) (ErrorStateKalmanFilter3D)

docs.title: State Vector
docs.text:
The state vector is defined in the vehicle navigation plane: $\(x = \begin{bmatrix} p_x & p_y & \theta & v & \omega \end{bmatrix}^T \in \mathbb{R}^2 \times S^1 \times \mathbb{R}^2\)$

Where: - \(p_x, p_y\): Global Cartesian position (meters) - \(\theta\): Heading / yaw angle normalized to \([-\pi, \pi)\) (radians) - \(v\): Longitudinal linear velocity (m/s) - \(\omega\): Yaw rate (rad/s)

docs.title: CTRV Motion Model Integration
docs.text:
For non-zero yaw rate (\(|\omega| > 10^{-5}\,\text{rad/s}\)), circular-arc integration is used:

\[\begin{aligned} p_x(t + \Delta t) &= p_x(t) + \frac{v}{\omega} \Big(\sin(\theta + \omega \Delta t) - \sin(\theta)\Big) \\ p_y(t + \Delta t) &= p_y(t) + \frac{v}{\omega} \Big(-\cos(\theta + \omega \Delta t) + \cos(\theta)\Big) \\ \theta(t + \Delta t) &= \text{wrap}\Big(\theta(t) + \omega \Delta t\Big) \\ v(t + \Delta t) &= v(t) \\ \omega(t + \Delta t) &= \omega(t) \end{aligned}\]

For \(|\omega| \le 10^{-5}\,\text{rad/s}\), a second-order midpoint Taylor expansion prevents division by zero: $\(\begin{aligned} \theta_{\text{mid}} &= \theta + \frac{1}{2} \omega \Delta t \\ p_x(t + \Delta t) &= p_x(t) + v \cos(\theta_{\text{mid}}) \Delta t \\ p_y(t + \Delta t) &= p_y(t) + v \sin(\theta_{\text{mid}}) \Delta t \end{aligned}\)$

docs.title: Continuous-to-Discrete Process Noise Projection
docs.text:
Process noise accounts for longitudinal acceleration noise \(\sigma_a^2\) and angular acceleration noise \(\sigma_\alpha^2\): $\(Q(\theta, \omega, \Delta t) = \Gamma \, Q_u \, \Gamma^T + Q_{\text{base}} \frac{\Delta t}{\Delta t_{\text{ref}}}\)$

\[\Gamma = \begin{bmatrix} \frac{1}{2} \Delta t^2 \cos(\theta_{\text{mid}}) & 0 \\ \frac{1}{2} \Delta t^2 \sin(\theta_{\text{mid}}) & 0 \\ 0 & \frac{1}{2} \Delta t^2 \\ \Delta t & 0 \\ 0 & \Delta t \end{bmatrix}, \quad Q_u = \begin{bmatrix} \sigma_a^2 & 0 \\ 0 & \sigma_\alpha^2 \end{bmatrix}\]

docs.title: Joseph Stabilized Measurement Update
docs.text: To guarantee that the updated error covariance remains symmetric positive semi-definite (\(P = P^T \ge 0\)): $\(P_{k|k} = (I - K_k H_k) P_{k|k-1} (I - K_k H_k)^T + K_k R_k K_k^T\)$

docs.title: Nominal and Error States
docs.text:
• Nominal State (16-D): $\(x_{\text{nom}} = \begin{bmatrix} p_{3\times 1} & v_{3\times 1} & q_{4\times 1} & b_{a, 3\times 1} & b_{\omega, 3\times 1} \end{bmatrix}^T\)$ Where \(q\) is a unit quaternion representing attitude on \(\text{SO}(3)\).
  • Error State (15-DOF): $\(\delta x = \begin{bmatrix} \delta p & \delta v & \delta \theta & \delta b_a & \delta b_\omega \end{bmatrix}^T \in \mathbb{R}^{15}\)$ Where \(\delta \theta \in \mathfrak{so}(3)\) is the rotation vector in the Lie algebra tangent space.

docs.title: Strapdown Inertial Mechanization
docs.text: Given accelerometer measurement \(a_m\) and gyroscope measurement \(\omega_m\): $\(a_b = a_m - b_a, \quad \omega_b = \omega_m - b_\omega\)$ $\(a_g = R(q) a_b + g_{\text{ENU}}\)$ $\(\dot{p} = v, \quad \dot{v} = a_g, \quad \dot{q} = \frac{1}{2} q \otimes \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ \omega_b \end{bmatrix}\)$

docs.title: Manifold State Injection & Error Reset
docs.text: When a measurement update produces error state \(\delta x\): $\(\begin{aligned} p &\leftarrow p + \delta p \\ v &\leftarrow v + \delta v \\ q &\leftarrow q \otimes \text{Exp}(\delta \theta) \\ b_a &\leftarrow b_a + \delta b_a \\ b_\omega &\leftarrow b_\omega + \delta b_\omega \end{aligned}\)$ $\(\delta x \leftarrow 0\)$

docs.title: 8-Screen Engineering Glass Cockpit
docs.text: The ApexPathAI glass-cockpit dashboard provides real-time telemetry streaming at 20 Hz over WebSockets, organized into 8 synchronized engineering sections.

docs.title: 1. Real-Time Vehicle Status
docs.text:
• Longitudinal speed gauge (km/h and m/s).
  • Acceleration vector (\(a_x, a_y\)) and total dynamic G-force.
  • Vehicle sideslip angle (\(\beta\)) and steering demand (\(\delta\)).
  • Brake and throttle actuation activity.

docs.title: 2. Localization Quality & Safety Integrity
docs.text:
• Estimated vs reference vehicle coordinates \([x, y, \theta]\).
  • Covariance trace \(\text{tr}(P)\) and uncertainty ellipse.
  • Horizontal Protection Level (HPL) with \(10^{-7}\) integrity risk bound.
  • Circular Error Probable (CEP50 and CEP95) error radii.

docs.title: 3. Sensor Health & Innovation Residuals
docs.text:
• Normalized Innovation Squared (NIS) charts across active sensor channels.
  • GNSS receiver fix quality (RTK Fixed, RTK Float, Dead Reckoning).
  • IMU gyro/accelerometer health and bias drift tracking.
  • LiDAR point-cloud inlier ratios and visual feature counts.

docs.title: 4. Route Tracking & Curvilinear Frenet Errors
docs.text:
• Cross-track error (\(e_y\)) and heading alignment error (\(e_\psi\)).
  • Dynamic clearance to left and right track boundaries.
  • Time-to-Boundary (TTB) collision avoidance margins.

docs.title: 5. Autonomy Quality & Chassis Dynamics
docs.text:
• Stanford phase-plane error metric (\(e_{\text{stanford}} = e_\psi + \arctan(k \cdot e_y / v)\)).
  • Tire friction circle utilization (\(\mu\)-meter).
  • Dynamic jerk (\(j_x, j_y\)) in \(\text{m/s}^3\).

docs.title: 6. Safety Events & Emergency Actuation
docs.text:
• Station-stamped safety event feed (INFO, WARN, CRITICAL).
  • Operator Emergency Stop (E-STOP) actuator and release controls.
  • Active disturbance indicators (GNSS outage, multipath, camera blinding).

docs.title: 7. Session Analytics & 7-Rule KPI Scorecard
docs.text:
• Current lap time, sector splits (S1, S2, S3), and delta-to-best.
  • Automated pass/fail status for all 7 regulatory rules.
  • Session lifecycle status (ARMED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, ABORTED).

docs.title: 8. Historical Analysis & Replay Scrubber
docs.text:
• Interactive timeline scrubber for seeking to specific simulation frames.
  • Forensic incident viewer reviewing +/- 50 frames around safety violations.
  • Comparative multi-lap velocity and lateral deviation overlays.

docs.title: Production Deployment with Docker Compose 🐳
docs.text: ApexPathAI provides fully containerized deployments utilizing Docker multi-stage builds and Docker Compose.

docs.title: Architecture Topology
docs.text:
The standard production deployment orchestrates four decoupled microservices:

Service Image Base Internal Port External Port Purpose frontend node:20-alpine \(\to\) nginx:alpine 80 3000 React 18 SPA with Nginx reverse proxy backend python:3.11-slim 8000 8000 FastAPI ASGI core & 20 Hz WebSocket broadcaster db postgres:16-alpine 5432 5432 Persistent relational storage (Sessions, Fleet, Reports) redis redis:7-alpine 6379 6379 High-throughput pub/sub telemetry cache

docs.title: 1. Configure Environment Variables
docs.text:
Create a production .env file based on .env.example:

cp .env.example .env

Key environment settings:

# Database Configuration
POSTGRES_USER=apexpath
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=apexpath_secret
POSTGRES_DB=apexpath_validation
DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://apexpath:apexpath_secret@db:5432/apexpath_validation

# Redis Pub/Sub Telemetry Broker
REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
REDIS_ENABLED=true

# Server Settings
HOST=0.0.0.0
PORT=8000
DEBUG=false
CORS_ORIGINS=["http://localhost:3000", "http://127.0.0.1:3000"]

# Optional Mapbox Access Token
MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=pk.your_mapbox_token_here

docs.title: 2. Build and Launch Containers
docs.text:
# Build multi-stage images and start in background
docker compose up --build -d

Verify service status:

docker compose ps

Expected output:

docs.title: 🔒 Production Security Hardening
docs.text:
When deploying on public or corporate proving ground networks:

  1. TLS / HTTPS Termination: Configure an edge load balancer or reverse proxy (e.g., Traefik, AWS ALB, Cloudflare) with valid SSL certificates.
  2. CORS Restrictions: Set CORS_ORIGINS in .env to match your exact production domain.
  3. Database Secrets: Generate a cryptographically strong database password (openssl rand -hex 24).
  4. Physical E-STOP Interlock: Always enforce hardware-level interlocks on physical vehicles alongside software emergency stops (POST /api/v1/monitoring/estop).

docs.title: Proving Ground Scenarios & Stress Replay
docs.text: ApexPathAI features a deterministic disturbance injection engine capable of stressing vehicle perception and state estimation stacks with edge-case scenarios.

docs.title: 1. Monza High-Speed Tunnel GNSS Blackout (monza_tunnel_blackout)
docs.text:
• Circuit: Monza (5,793 m)
  • Target Velocity: 24.5 m/s (88 km/h)
  • Disturbance: Complete loss of GNSS signal (\(10.0\,\text{s}\) duration) in Sector 2 between stations 150m and 250m.
  • Evaluation Goal: Validates inertial dead-reckoning drift and fallback to LiDAR/visual odometry under high-speed cornering.

docs.title: 2. Spa Extreme Weather & Surface Friction Drop (spa_friction_drop)
docs.text:
• Circuit: Spa-Francorchamps (7,004 m)
  • Target Velocity: 22.0 m/s
  • Disturbance: Sudden friction coefficient reduction (\(\mu = 0.45\)) and camera feature degradation (blinding spray).
  • Evaluation Goal: Validates sideslip angle (\(\beta\)) monitoring and path containment under low-grip conditions.

docs.title: 3. Melbourne Urban Canyon Multipath Reflection (melbourne_multipath)
docs.text:
• Circuit: Melbourne Albert Park (5,278 m)
  • Target Velocity: 20.0 m/s
  • Disturbance: High-variance satellite multipath reflection noise (\(\sigma_{\text{GPS}} = 4.5\,\text{m}\)) and intermittent \(15\,\text{m}\) position jumps.
  • Evaluation Goal: Stresses the Mahalanobis chi-squared innovation gate and verifies consecutive rejection recovery.

docs.title: Circular Recording & Forensic Replay
docs.text:
During test execution, StressReplayEngine maintains a circular buffer of TelemetryFrame structures recording: - True ground-truth vs estimated pose \([x, y, \theta]\) - Instantaneous lateral error (\(e_y\)) and heading error (\(e_\psi\)) - Sensor availability flags (GNSS fix, camera feature tracking, LiDAR inlier ratio) - Protection levels (HPL) and track margin clearance

When an anomaly or threshold violation occurs, the engine automatically extracts an incident snapshot (capturing 50 frames before and after the event) for forensic analysis in the engineering dashboard.

docs.title: Automated 7-Rule KPI Scorecard
docs.text: ApexPathAI evaluates closed-loop test sessions against 7 automated validation rules inspired by ISO 21448 (Safety of the Intended Functionality - SOTIF) and autonomous racing integrity standards.

docs.title: The 7 Regulatory Rules
docs.text: Rule Metric Name Threshold Failure Condition Target Standard Rule 1 2D Position Accuracy (RMSE) \(\le 0.35\,\text{m}\) Filter divergence or excessive drift Lane-keeping accuracy Rule 2 Lateral Tracking Error (\(e_y\)) \(\le 0.60\,\text{m}\) Vehicle oscillates or cuts corners Dynamic stability Rule 3 Geofence Boundary Margin \(\ge 0.50\,\text{m}\) Proximity violation with track walls Collision prevention Rule 4 Horizontal Protection Level (HPL) \(\le 3.00\,\text{m}\) Integrity risk exceeds \(10^{-7}\) Safety integrity monitoring Rule 5 Normalized Estimation Error (NEES) \([2.0, 5.5]\) Filter over-confident or under-confident Kalman statistical consistency Rule 6 Real-Time Execution Latency \(\le 5.0\,\text{ms}\) Solver overrun or deadline miss Real-time determinism Rule 7 Operator Disengagements \(= 0\) Safety disengagement triggered Autonomous mission success

docs.title: Scorecard Lifecycle & State Machine
docs.text:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> IDLE
    IDLE --> ARMED: Operator Arms Session
    ARMED --> RUNNING: Session Starts
    RUNNING --> PAUSED: Operator Pauses
    PAUSED --> RUNNING: Operator Resumes
    RUNNING --> COMPLETED: Target Laps Reached (Scorecard Generated)
    RUNNING --> ABORTED: E-STOP or Safety Boundary Breach
    COMPLETED --> [*]
    ABORTED --> [*]

docs.title: Overall Session Verdict
docs.text: A test session achieves an OVERALL PASS if and only if: 1. The session is not aborted (no E-STOP or operator termination). 2. All 7 regulatory rules simultaneously achieve passed == True. 3. All target laps are successfully completed.
